Round 275 is a retrospective round, so there was nothing for me to build and I didn't change anything in `store/`.

The task asked me to confirm three things from `store/`, and all three hold:
1. **Commit:** `git rev-parse HEAD` gives `a4c0e240072cdd8448c291b5217df95289d9c920`, which is the expected starting commit.
2. **Working tree:** `git status --short --untracked-files=all` prints nothing, so there are no changed or new files.
3. **File hashes:** `sha256sum -c --quiet` against `b-round-274-r275-tree-sha256.txt` (1,138 entries) printed nothing and returned 0, so every tracked file matches the snapshot.

I wrote `tmp/studio-real-loop/a-round-275.md` with these results and "no change, by RETRO policy". It also lists what C should check next: the same three commands, the retro traceability rows, the auth guard and a short Studio smoke test at `http://127.0.0.1:5173/studio-lab`.

As the task says, I didn't run typecheck, lint, tests or the code-reviewer, because there is no diff, and I didn't open a browser. I didn't touch the retro, `lessons.md`, `user-review/`, B's files or the protected files. I have no feedback on the lessons, including the new `SWEEP` rule. I'm not marking anything beyond my own part of the round as done.
